chapter: Returning to the US and the Savoy band
title: What longer-lasting bands might have achieved
summary: With backing his band could have lasted long enough to take with the public.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: If there had been a way of keeping

these bands together long enough so that the public could become familiar with them, but that might have been a way to give them these long histories that so many -- I mean these identities over so many years that some other bands had.
Uh huh. Well, it's too bad. You'd have been also working at a lot of one night stands, and living that kind of a life for a long period, too.
Well, this band then sort of had a number of engagements towards the end of 1939, early 1940 -- I can't say it dissipates; I mean everybody is still there, but they are all doing different things.
